rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AB/full blastocyst description, but it overstates quality as 'high-quality'/'good-to-strong' and describes TE somewhat more favorably than the lab grade of B with relatively few loosely arranged cells.

Integrates age, prior live birth, male factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, BMI, and ovarian markers reasonably well with embryo quality, though AMH is unavailable and some factors like former smoking/stress are given slightly more weight than evidence supports.

The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with prognosis logically tied to embryo morphology and patient factors; minor issue is somewhat optimistic framing relative to a 2AB embryo and untested status.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, routine luteal support, no bed rest, avoidance of unproven add-ons, and selective rather than automatic PGT-A. Minor deviations include speculative emphasis on former smoking/stress effects.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle advice, and when to consider further workup; useful though not highly individualized beyond standard IVF care.
